title: Permutationally symmetric molecular aggregates
summary: Linear optical spectra of molecular aggregates are often approximated by classical optics methods such as the discrete-dipole approximation (DDA), coherent exciton scattering (CES), and coherent potential approximation (CPA), where the only quantum-mechanical input to the calculation is the linear susceptibility of the monomers. However, the limits of validity of these classical optics methods remain opaque.
